block.title: Which split a decision tree prefers
block.body: A decision tree picks split B, because even groups look balanced and split B leaves purer groups. In split A the groups are 3 and 1, so the weighted Gini is 0.625. In split B each group is 2 and 2, so Gini = 0.5. Because 0.5 is lower than 0.625, split B is chosen.
